events.name: project_profile
cypher:
MATCH (p:Project {id: $id})<-[:DEVELOPS]-(c:Company)
OPTIONAL MATCH (g:Group)-[:CONTROLS]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Person)-[dir:DIRECTOR_OF]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:BUILT_ON]->(l:LandParcel)
OPTIONAL MATCH (con:Contractor)-[:BUILDS]->(p)
OPTIONAL MATCH (len:Lender)-[:FINANCES]->(p)
RETURN p {.*} AS project, c.name AS company, c.status AS company_status, c.incorporated AS incorporated,
       g.name AS brand, g.brand_since AS brand_since,
       collect(DISTINCT d.name) AS directors, l.name AS land, l.khata AS khata, l.acres AS acres,
       con.name AS contractor, len.name AS lender

MATCH (p:Project {id: $id})-[:HAS_APPROVAL]->(a:Approval)
RETURN a.type AS type, a.status AS status, a.year AS year, a.ref AS ref ORDER BY a.year

MATCH (p:Project {id: $id})<-[:AGAINST]-(c:Complaint)
RETURN c.status AS status, c.category AS category, count(c) AS n

events.name: land_title_check
cypher:
MATCH (p:Project {id: $id})-[b:BUILT_ON]->(l:LandParcel)
OPTIONAL MATCH (l)-[po:PREVIOUSLY_OWNED_BY]->(o)
OPTIONAL MATCH (k:CourtCase)-[:INVOLVES]->(x) WHERE x = l OR x = o
RETURN p.name AS project, l.id AS land_id, l.name AS land, l.khata AS khata, l.acres AS acres,
       o.id AS owner_id, o.name AS previous_owner, o.kind AS owner_kind, po.until AS owned_until,
       collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN k IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
           {id: k.id, case_no: k.case_no, court: k.court, nature: k.nature, status: k.status,
            filed: k.filed, parties: k.parties, involves: x.name} END) AS cases

events.name: trace_risk

output.note: No red flag is connected to this project within 4 hops. That means no known connection in the graph, not a guarantee that the project is safe.
output.how_to_read: risk_score 0-100 = 100*(1-exp(-K)); K sums severity * 0.6^(hops-1) * edge weights over every path to a red flag within 4 hops. share_pct = share of K from that flag; n_paths = how many distinct paths reach it.

cypher:
MATCH path = (p:Project {id: $id})-[:DEVELOPS|DIRECTOR_OF|CONTROLS|BUILT_ON|PREVIOUSLY_OWNED_BY|INVOLVES|AGAINST|HAS_APPROVAL|BUILDS*1..4]-(f:RedFlag)
WHERE f <> p
  AND none(n IN nodes(path)[1..-1] WHERE n.kind = 'Project')
  AND size([r IN relationships(path) WHERE type(r) = 'PREVIOUSLY_OWNED_BY']) <= 1
RETURN f.id AS flag_id, f.kind AS flag_kind, f.name AS flag_name, f.reason AS reason,
       f.severity AS severity, f.created_at AS created_at, length(path) AS hops,
       [n IN nodes(path) | {id: n.id, kind: n.kind, name: n.name}] AS nodes,
       [r IN relationships(path) | type(r)] AS rels
LIMIT 2001

**Case C-3d35860e: land title check**

Neither project had an earlier finding in the buyer's memory.

**PRJ-081 Banyan Grove Whispering Woods: SAFE, risk 0 (LOW)**
- **Surface view:** Under construction, 2–3 BHK, ₹92–158 lakh. Possession is promised for 2029. Banyan Habitats III LLP is active and was incorporated in 2013. The RERA, BBMP plan and CC approvals are granted. One delay complaint is resolved and none are open.
- **Title chain:** The project sits on Sy. No. 128/5, Kodathi, which is A-khata land of 10.5 acres. The previous owner was Vidya Khan, an individual, who owned it until 2024. Chain: project → land parcel → Vidya Khan (owner until 2024).
- **Disputes and encumbrances:** The graph has no court case connected to the land or to the previous owner. The graph also links no red flag to the project within 4 hops. That means no known connection in the graph, not a guarantee.

**PRJ-082 Greenfield Sarjapur Greens: SAFE, risk 0 (LOW)**
- **Surface view:** Under construction, 2–3 BHK, ₹88–150 lakh, 560 units. It is running 2 months late against a 2027 possession date. Greenfield Devanahalli Projects Pvt Ltd is active and was incorporated in 2010. Malnad Capital is the lender and Vajra Engineering the contractor. The approvals are granted. One delay complaint is resolved and none are open.
- **Title chain:** The project sits on Sy. No. 228/8, Kodathi, which is A-khata land of 7.3 acres. The previous owner was Mary Gowda, an individual, who owned it until 2022. Chain: project → land parcel → Mary Gowda (owner until 2022).
- **Disputes and encumbrances:** The graph has no court case connected to the land or to the previous owner. It also links no red flag to the project within 4 hops.

Both findings were verified and recorded.

**What to verify offline for both projects**
- Check the encumbrance certificate and the title deed history for the full ownership chain. The graph only shows one previous owner for each plot.
- Look for any gap or sale between the previous owner's end year (2024 for PRJ-081, 2022 for PRJ-082) and the developer's acquisition.
- Confirm the A-khata status and the RERA registration on the official portals.
- Check for any mortgage on the land. The graph shows no lender for PRJ-081. Malnad Capital finances PRJ-082, so ask whether the land is charged to it.
